posts.trend: How Indians can build a diabetes-friendly lifestyle without extreme diets
posts.context: Urban Indians are hitting their thirties and realizing their bodies are starting to break down from a decade of poor lifestyle choices.
posts.angle: Your mother's daily check-in call undergoes a subtle but terrifying shift from emotional to medical.
slides: The three questions your mother asks in a single call.

"Khana kha liya?"

"Roti mein ghee toh nahi lagaya?"

"Sugar check kiya ki nahi?"

You are thirty-two.

She still treats you like an unstable chemical.
posts.caption: The transition is complete. You are now a medical project. 📞
posts.rank_verdict: The hook leans too close to generic Indian family meme territory instead of a distinct, sharp documentary.
